environment.description: Application deployed behind an envoy sidecar proxy (v1.28) in an ECS Fargate task. The envoy configuration includes an ext_authz HTTP filter chain that invokes a Lua script performing request normalization. The Lua filter applies percent-decoding and then matches the decoded query string values against a pattern set using RE2 engine. The pattern set includes entries for common SQL metacharacters in non-alphanumeric positions: specifically any query parameter value containing an unescaped single-quote followed by a parenthesis or SQL keyword boundary (pattern: `[^\w]'[^']*(?:SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|DROP|UNION|OR|AND)[^']*` with case-insensitive flag). Additionally, the ECS task definition sets the container filesystem as read-only with a tmpfs mount at /tmp only, and the SQLite database volume is mounted from an EFS access point configured with uid/gid enforcement and POSIX permissions 0444 on the database file, with a separate init container that seeds the database before the app starts.

config.proxy: Envoy 1.28 sidecar with Lua HTTP filter
config.lua_filter_action: Percent-decode all query param values, then RE2 match against SQL injection pattern set, return 403 on match
config.filesystem: Read-only root filesystem on ECS Fargate task
config.database_mount: EFS access point, POSIX uid=1000 gid=1000, file permissions 0444
config.database_init: Seeded by init container before app container starts
config.network: Private subnet, no direct internet access, ALB in front with TLS termination
